about_the_game:
We’ve got all kinds of good stuff at a discount for you during Wargaming Publisher Weekend. There’s only one thing better than something at a discount, though, and that’s something for free!

Here’s what you’ll get in the free White Hot Pack:
  • 1 day of WoT Premium
  • ×3 tokens for ×5 XP missions
  • ×3 projection decals “Wild HEAT”
  • ×3 inscriptions “Fire Fire Baby”

All you need to do in order to claim these items is log-in to World of Tanks anytime between now and February 27. Don’t forget to check out all of the other huge discounts we have on things like Premium vehicle bundles and more throughout Wargaming Publisher Weekend.

DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.
You will be able to use this DLC only if you play from the game account created on Steam.
This DLC is only available until February 27.
